title: Future continuous / perfect
recall: Future continuous va future perfect nima uchun kerak? by bilan misol keltir.
formula: will be + -ing: kelajakdagi bir lahzada davom etayotgan — This time tomorrow I'll be flying
will have + V3: kelajakdagi nuqtagacha tugagan — By Friday I'll have finished the report
will have been + -ing: kelajakdagi nuqtagacha davomiylik — By June I'll have been working here for 5 years

items.uz: Ertaga shu vaqtda men samolyotda uchayotgan bo'laman.
en: This time tomorrow I'll be flying.
This time tomorrow I will be flying.
This time tomorrow I'll be on the plane.

items.uz: Juma kuniga qadar hisobotni tugatib bo'laman.
en: I'll have finished the report by Friday.
By Friday I'll have finished the report.
I will have finished the report by Friday.

items.uz: Soat 9 da qo'ng'iroq qilma — ovqatlanayotgan bo'laman.
en: Don't call at 9 — I'll be having dinner.
Don't call me at 9, I'll be having dinner.
Don't call at 9; I'll be eating dinner.

items.uz: Kelasi yilga qadar 1000 so'z o'rganib bo'laman.
en: By next year I'll have learned 1000 words.
I'll have learnt 1000 words by next year.
By next year, I will have learned 1000 words.

items.uz: Iyunga kelib bu yerda 5 yil ishlagan bo'laman.
en: By June I'll have been working here for 5 years.
By June I'll have worked here for 5 years.
By June I will have been working here for five years.

items.uz: Sen kelganingda men uxlayotgan bo'laman.
en: I'll be sleeping when you arrive.
When you arrive, I'll be sleeping.
I'll be asleep when you come.

items.uz: Ertaga do'konga borasanmi? Menga non olib kel. (so'rov)
en: Will you be going to the shop tomorrow? Can you get me some bread?
Will you be going to the shop tomorrow? Could you buy me some bread?

items.uz: Film tugaganida ular kelib bo'lishadi.
en: They'll have arrived by the time the film ends.
By the time the film ends, they'll have arrived.

items.uz: Kelasi hafta shu paytda men dengizda dam olayotgan bo'laman.
en: This time next week I'll be relaxing on the beach.
This time next week I'll be lying on the beach.
This time next week I will be relaxing by the sea.

items.uz: Yil oxiriga qadar marafonga tayyorlanib bo'laman.
en: I'll have prepared for the marathon by the end of the year.
By the end of the year I'll have prepared for the marathon.

items.uz: Soat 10 da u hali ham ishlayotgan bo'ladi.
en: At 10 he'll still be working.
He'll still be working at 10.
At ten he will still be working.

items.uz: Pul tugab qoladi oy oxirigacha.
en: The money will have run out by the end of the month.
We'll have run out of money by the end of the month.

items.uz: Siz bugun kechqurun ofisda bo'lasizmi?
en: Will you be staying at the office tonight?
Will you be working at the office this evening?
Will you be in the office this evening?

items.uz: Ertaga shu vaqtda imtihon topshirayotgan bo'laman.
en: This time tomorrow I'll be taking the exam.
This time tomorrow I'll be sitting the exam.
This time tomorrow I will be taking my exam.

items.uz: U uyga kelguncha men ovqat pishirib bo'laman.
en: I'll have cooked dinner by the time she gets home.
By the time she gets home, I'll have cooked dinner.

items.uz: 2030-yilga kelib ular uy qurib bo'lishadi.
en: By 2030 they'll have built the house.
They'll have built the house by 2030.

items.uz: Kechqurun men kitob o'qiyotgan bo'laman, kelaver.
en: I'll be reading in the evening, so come over.
I'll be reading this evening, just come.

items.uz: Siz kelganingizda biz ketib bo'lamiz.
en: We'll have left by the time you arrive.
By the time you arrive, we'll have left.
We will have left when you arrive.

items.uz: Soat 7 da yuguryotgan bo'laman.
en: At 7 I'll be running.
I'll be running at 7.
At seven I'll be running.

items.uz: Bir oydan keyin bu kitobni o'qib chiqqan bo'laman.
en: In a month I'll have finished this book.
I'll have read this book in a month.
In a month I'll have read this book.

speak: Ertaga soat 8, 12 va 18 da nima qilayotgan bo'lasiz? (future continuous)
Yil oxiriga qadar nimalarni qilib bo'lasiz? (future perfect) — 5 ta gap.
6 oydan keyin ingliz tilingiz qanday bo'ladi? (will have)
